articles.title_en: The Cost of Bank Regulatory Capital
articles.abstract_en: Basel I introduced capital requirements for undrawn commitments, but only for revolvers with an original maturity greater than one year. We use this regulatory discontinuity to estimate the impact of capital regulation on the cost and composition of credit. Following Basel I, short-term commitment fees declined relative to long-term commitments and issuance of short-term facilities increased. Our results highlight the sensitivity of credit provision to capital regulation, particularly for banks with less capital. We are able to infer that low-capital banks are willing to forego twice as much income from fees to reduce required regulatory capital by a dollar.
articles.abstract_cn: 巴塞尔协议I对未提取承诺引入了资本要求，但仅针对原始期限超过一年的循环贷款。我们利用这一监管不连续性来估计资本监管对信贷成本及构成的影响。在巴塞尔协议I之后，短期承诺费相对于长期承诺有所下降，且短期融资工具的发行增加。我们的结果凸显了信贷供给对资本监管的敏感性，尤其是对资本较少的银行。我们能够推断出，低资本银行愿意放弃两倍于减少一美元所需监管资本的费用收入。

articles.title_en: Macroprudential Policy, Mortgage Cycles, and Distributional Effects: Evidence from the United Kingdom
articles.title_cn: 宏观审慎政策、抵押贷款周期与分配效应：来自英国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the distributional effects of macroprudential policy on mortgage cycles by exploiting the U.K. mortgage register and a 2014 15% limit imposed on lenders’ high loan-to-income (LTI) mortgages. Constrained lenders issue fewer and more expensive high-LTI mortgages, with stronger effects on low-income borrowers. Unconstrained lenders strongly substitute high-LTI loans in local areas with higher constrained lender presence, but not high-LTI loans to low-income borrowers—consistent with adverse selection problems—implying lower overall credit to low-income borrowers. Consistently, policy-affected areas experience lower house price growth postregulation and, following the Brexit referendum (negative aggregate shock), better house price growth and lower mortgage defaults for low-income borrowers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用英国抵押贷款登记册和2014年对贷款人高贷款收入比（LTI）抵押贷款实施的15%上限，分析了宏观审慎政策对抵押贷款周期的分配效应。受约束的贷款人发放的高LTI抵押贷款数量更少且价格更高，对低收入借款人的影响更为显著。不受约束的贷款人在受约束贷款人存在度较高的地区大量替代高LTI贷款，但并未向低收入借款人提供高LTI贷款——这与逆向选择问题一致——意味着低收入借款人的总体信贷减少。与此一致，受政策影响的地区在监管后房价增长放缓，而在英国脱欧公投（负面总体冲击）之后，低收入借款人的房价增长表现更好且抵押贷款违约率更低。

articles.title_en: Local Effects of Global Capital Flows: A China Shock in the U.S. Housing Market
articles.title_cn: 全球资本流动的本地效应：美国房地产市场中的中国冲击
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the real effects of foreign real estate capital inflows. Using transaction-level data, we document (i) a “China shock” in the U.S. housing market characterized by surging foreign Chinese housing purchases after 2008, and (ii) “home bias” in these purchases, as they concentrate in neighborhoods historically populated by ethnic Chinese. Exploiting their temporal and spatial variation, we find that these capital inflows raise local employment, with the effect transmitted through a housing net worth channel. However, they displace local lower-income residents. Our results show that real estate capital inflows can both stimulate the real economy and induce gentrification.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了外国房地产资本流入的实际效应。利用交易层面的数据，我们记录了（i）美国房地产市场中的“中国冲击”，其特征是2008年后外国中国购房者激增，以及（ii）这些购房中的“本土偏好”，因为它们集中在历史上由华裔居住的社区。利用其时间和空间变化，我们发现这些资本流入提高了当地就业，其效应通过住房净值渠道传导。然而，它们挤出了当地低收入居民。我们的结果表明，房地产资本流入既能刺激实体经济，也能引发绅士化。

articles.title_en: Desperate House Sellers: Distress among Developers
articles.title_cn: 绝望的房屋卖家：开发商中的困境
articles.abstract_en: I identify the effect of financial constraints on product prices using granular data on home-builder housing developments from the 2006–2009 housing crisis. Builders who experience losses in one area subsequently sell homes in unaffected areas at a discount to raise cash quickly. When builders cut prices, they sell homes faster and builders cut prices more in areas in which price cuts produce larger declines in time-to-sale. Financially constrained firms are more likely to cut prices of homes in healthy areas following losses elsewhere. Firms cut prices following losses in other projects only during the crisis, not during the boom.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用2006-2009年住房危机期间房屋建筑商住房开发的微观数据，识别了金融约束对产品价格的影响。在一个地区遭受损失的建筑商随后会在未受影响地区以折扣价出售房屋，以快速筹集现金。当建筑商降价时，他们能更快地出售房屋，并且在降价导致销售时间下降幅度更大的地区，建筑商降价更多。财务受限的公司更有可能在其他地方遭受损失后，在健康地区降低房屋价格。公司仅在危机期间，而非繁荣期间，在其他项目遭受损失后降价。

articles.title_en: Flight to Safety: How Economic Downturns Affect Talent Flows to Startups
articles.title_cn: 避险行为：经济衰退如何影响人才流向初创企业
articles.abstract_en: Using proprietary data from AngelList Talent, we study how startup job seekers’ search and application behavior changed during the COVID-19 downturn. We find that workers shifted their searches and applications away from less-established startups and toward more-established ones, even within the same individual over time. At the firm level, this shift was not offset by an influx of new job seekers. Less-established startups experienced a relative decline in the quantity and quality of applications, ultimately affecting their hiring. Our findings uncover a flight-to-safety channel in the labor market that may amplify the procyclical nature of entrepreneurial activities.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用AngelList Talent的专有数据，我们研究了在COVID-19衰退期间初创企业求职者的搜索和申请行为如何变化。我们发现，工人将他们的搜索和申请从不太成熟的初创企业转向更成熟的企业，即使在同一个体随时间的变化中也是如此。在企业层面，这种转变并未被新求职者的涌入所抵消。不太成熟的初创企业经历了申请数量和质量相对下降，最终影响了他们的招聘。我们的发现揭示了劳动力市场中的避险渠道，这可能放大创业活动的顺周期性。

articles.title_en: The Rise of Star Firms: Intangible Capital and Competition
articles.title_cn: 明星企业的崛起：无形资本与竞争
articles.abstract_en: The large divergence in the returns of top-performing star firms and the rest of the economy is substantially reduced when we account for the mismeasurement of intangible capital. Star firms produce and invest more per dollar in invested capital, have more valuable innovations as measured by the market value of patents, and are as exposed to competitive shocks as nonstars. Star firms have higher markups that are predicted early in their life cycle at a time when they are small. Overall, after we correct for the mismeasurement of intangibles, the evidence points to the superior ability of star firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 当我们考虑无形资本计量误差时，顶级表现明星企业与经济中其他企业之间的巨大回报差异大幅缩小。明星企业每美元投资资本产生和投资更多，其专利市场价值衡量的创新更有价值，并且与非明星企业一样面临竞争冲击。明星企业具有更高的加成率，这在其生命周期早期规模尚小时即可预测。总体而言，在纠正无形资本计量误差后，证据指向明星企业的卓越能力。

articles.title_en: Scale or Yield? A Present-Value Identity
articles.title_cn: 规模还是收益率？一个现值恒等式
articles.abstract_en: We propose a loglinear present-value identity in which investment (“scale”), profitability (“yield”), and discount rates determine a firm’s market-to-book ratio. Our identity reconciles existing influential market-to-book decompositions and facilitates novel insights from three empirical applications: (1) Both investment and profitability are important contributors to the value spread and stock return news variance. (2) Any cross-sectional return predictability has a mirror image in cash-flow fundamentals, providing asset pricing theories with additional moments to match. (3) The investment spread significantly improves the predictability of time-series variation in the value premium and justifies the poor performance of value in recent years.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个对数线性现值恒等式，其中投资（“规模”）、盈利能力（“收益率”）和贴现率决定了企业的市值账面比。我们的恒等式调和了现有有影响力的市值账面比分解，并从三个实证应用中促进了新颖见解：（1）投资和盈利能力都是价值价差和股票收益新闻方差的重要贡献者。（2）任何横截面收益可预测性在现金流基本面中都有镜像，为资产定价理论提供了额外的匹配矩。（3）投资价差显著提高了价值溢价时间序列变化的可预测性，并解释了近年来价值表现不佳的原因。

articles.title_en: Existence of the Wealth-Consumption Ratio in Asset Pricing Models with Recursive Preferences
articles.title_cn: 递归偏好资产定价模型中财富-消费比率的存在性
articles.abstract_en: Modern asset pricing models combine recursive preferences with complex dynamics for the underlying consumption process. The existence of solutions is for many of these models an unsettled question. This paper introduces a novel technique to prove existence and nonexistence, as well as uniqueness for models with recursive preferences. The approach applies to many models of interest, including those with long-run consumption risks, with stochastic volatility and jumps, with time-varying consumption disasters, and with smooth ambiguity aversion and learning. Collectively, the proven results settle the existence question for many of today’s leading asset pricing models.
articles.abstract_cn: 现代资产定价模型将递归偏好与基础消费过程的复杂动态相结合。对于许多此类模型，解的存在性是一个尚未解决的问题。本文引入了一种新技术来证明存在性和不存在性，以及递归偏好模型的唯一性。该方法适用于许多感兴趣的模型，包括具有长期消费风险、随机波动率和跳跃、时变消费灾难以及平滑模糊厌恶和学习的模型。总体而言，所证明的结果为当今许多领先的资产定价模型解决了存在性问题。
